title: Tech Brief
summary: A local inference engine changes its public API, followed by two projects worth exploring.

stories.title: llama.cpp revises its public inference API
stories.change: The release removes deprecated public interfaces and exposes speculative decoding in llama.h.
stories.why: If you embed llama.cpp directly, check your bindings before upgrading.
stories.try: Read the migration notes and build the tagged version.

stories.title: Read a model card before choosing weights
stories.what: A worked example of an open-weight model card.
stories.change: This reading illustrates how to compare model variants.
stories.why: Weights, inference requirements and license terms are separate diligence checks.
stories.try: Open the model card and inspect its files and license.
stories.access: Check terms in the model card
